# M1-11 — GitHub Repository & Team Governance Setup

## Labels
`chore`, `infra`, `milestone-1`, `priority-critical`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Create the single controlled team repository
- [ ] Apply the suggested folder structure (docs/, src/, tests/, .github/)
- [ ] Protect the `main` branch (no direct pushes for substantive changes)
- [ ] Configure required Pull Requests with a minimum of two approvals from non-authors
- [ ] Disable self-approval
- [ ] Add `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`
- [ ] Set up labels (type / milestone / priority) per `labels.md`
- [ ] Set up the four GitHub Milestones (M1–M4)
- [ ] Set up a project board / backlog and link issues to it
- [ ] Confirm `.gitignore` excludes secrets, and no credentials are ever committed
- [ ] Verify settings with a screenshot + live walkthrough for presentation evidence

## Acceptance Criteria
- `main` is protected; a direct push attempt is blocked (demonstrable live).
- A test PR shows the two-approval rule enforced and self-approval rejected.
- Labels and milestones exist and are applied consistently across open issues.
- Repository history shows authentic, progressive activity from the start of M1 (not a bulk upload before assessment).
